notes.title: Kingdom Mode Arrives!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We're thrilled to announce the release of a major update to UNDYING—Version 1.0! This update marks the launch of Kingdom Mode, a standalone application (separate launch option) offering a fresh and immersive gaming experience unlike anything before.

[b]New Base and Building Mode:
[/b]Good news: LynnBay is your new home, ready for your creative touch!
Bad news: Your previous home is no more, but embrace the opportunity to shape LynnBay to your desires using the building system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/66002ec87f88025f3ca8aeb805c813ce635e8468.jpg[/img]

[b]Transport Mechanism:
[/b]Now, transport a wide range of items from around the world and furnish your home as you wish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/1e71cdc66def76f7de77648cefe0f3e8ffefa5ce.png[/img]

[b]Research Mechanism:
[/b]Discover and unlock new constructions by researching facilities left behind by other survivors, enhancing your survival capabilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/73ff55c5e68eaae9112adfe38d239a01f88cf27b.png[/img]

[b]NPC Settlement:
[/b]Welcome NPCs to your camp, providing them with essential resources to expand and fortify your community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/81bbaaeb4951507c63ce9918463b7f01dd9c90f9.png[/img]

[b]Enemy Invasion:
[/b]Prepare for regular zombie invasions and defend your camp to ensure your continued survival.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/53b364ab75c3be77ab7ce7c28f17abf4f1374b6c.png[/img]

[b]World Map and Traveling:
[/b]Upgrade your car and unlock new locations on the world map, assisting fallen areas to maintain order in Aries Town.

[b]Order System:
[/b]Fulfill order tasks from NPCs to obtain valuable resources and enhance your homestead.

[b]Scene Resources and Levels:[/b]
[list][*] Discover a wealth of scene resources to aid in your survival journey, but beware—resources no longer respawn once depleted.
[*] Nearly everything in the scene can be destroyed, but be mindful as they won't respawn once destroyed.
[*] Explore expanded territories and hidden map areas teeming with resources and challenges.
[/list]
[b]Transportation Challenges:[/b]
While there's plenty to transport, be prepared for the challenge of hauling items back to your base using a trolley.

[b]Storage Solutions:
[/b]Store items in various storage boxes scattered throughout scenes, eliminating the need for loading bars.

[b]Ground Materials:
[/b]No more animation process for picking up ground materials, but remember, items left on the ground will disappear when you leave.

[b]Known Issues:  [/b]
Please note that certain issues may exist during gameplay. We are aware of these potential challenges and are prioritizing our workload to address them based on player feedback and internal testing. Some of the Known Issues
[list]
[*] Improper or incorrect language translation
[*] Incomplete or incorrect interaction icons
[*] Incorrect AI attack behavior
[*] Pathfinding/ground physics errors
[*] Cody/NPC/enemy AI getting stuck or behaving abnormally
[*] Some production manufacturing behaviors/interface displays are incorrect
[*] The number or intensity of enemies in levels is unreasonable
[*] Issues caused by various inaccurate values
[*] Various rendering or visual effect errors
[/list]
[b]Protagonist Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Experience new interactions and challenges as the protagonist's abilities evolve.
[*] Anling is now accompanied by a fully grown Cody, ready to face the challenges of survival together.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We're committed to delivering an exceptional gaming experience and look forward to embarking on this thrilling journey with you in UNDYING Kingdom Mode.

notes.content:
Dear Moms,

We're thrilled to announce some significant improvements to the loading issues you may have encountered in story mode levels. We understand the frustration these issues may have caused, and we apologize for any inconvenience. 
Balancing the introduction of new gameplay with the resolution of existing problems has been our top priority, and we appreciate your patience and support.

If you encounter any similar issues during your gaming sessions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Official Discord server at discord.gg/playundying. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve the game.

In other exciting news, we're thrilled to announce that the first version of "Kingdom Mode" (version: Pioneering) is almost ready for launch! Stay tuned for more updates on this eagerly awaited feature.

Thank you for being part of the Undying community, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting experiences in the future.

Warm regards,

The Vanimals Dev Team

notes.title: Patch Update March 29
notes.content:
Dear Moms,

We hope this message finds you well! We're thrilled to share some exciting updates and fixes that we've been diligently working on to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a rundown of what's new:

[h3]Data Balancing:[/h3]

[b]Tranquil Difficulty: [/b]We've heard your feedback, and under the [Tranquil] difficulty setting, we've boosted the durability of all weapons from 140% to 160%, making your survival journey even smoother.

[b]Increased Base Durability:[/b] We've made adjustments to the base durability of several weapons to ensure better gameplay balance:
[list]
[*] Crowbar: 20 → 30
[*] Handgun: 40 → 50
[*] Pickaxe: 20 → 30
[*] Chainsaw: 200 → 300
[/list]
[b]Enhancement Options:[/b] Now, you can enhance the durability of select weapons right from the comfort of your home! Here's a list of weapons and the number of enhancement levels available:
[list]
[*] Handgun: 3 levels
[*] Shotgun: 3 levels
[*] Pickaxe: 3 levels
[*] Slingshot: 5 levels
[*] War Sword: 5 levels
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

We've squashed pesky bugs to ensure a smoother gaming experience:
[list]
[*] No more interruptions in background music (BGMs) or sound effects (SFXs).
[*] You can now revisit the enhancement banner using your keyboard after reaching the maximum enhancement level for weapons.
[*] Various minor UI issues have been addressed and fixed.
[/list]
We're also excited to announce that a preview video showcasing our progress on the highly anticipated Kingdom Mode (survival mode) will be available very soon! Stay tuned for an exclusive sneak peek!

As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter any issues or have suggestions for further improvements. Your support and enthusiasm drive us to create the best gaming experience possible.

Best regards,

Vanimals Team
Skystone Team

Greetings, everyone, and happy holidays! We've got the next update for Undying as well as free Christmas gifts for everyone to enjoy! Check out the notes below! 

[h3]Free DLC[/h3]

New skins for Anling:
1. Future Cyborg Outfit + Wig
2. Pilot Suit + Cap.

New skins for Cody:
1. Sheriff Outfit + Hat.
2. Pilot Suit + Cap.
We also have three new soundtrack previews to the Soundtrack Preview OST!

[h3]Reminder about the Free DLC![/h3]

Remember to claim the free DLCs now, they are free for all players during the EA period and will be yours forever, even after the game fully releases next year!

[h3]Gameplay Experience Optimization[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where the enemy respawn frequency was always set to be the slowest when starting a new game in survival mode. 
2. Fixed an error in the difficulty of the settlement interface when triggering the end of the current version in story mode.
3. Optimized the interaction logic of "Help Cody" to prevent it from being triggered incorrectly in certain cases.
4. Fixed an issue where Anling could still trigger some interactions when in her Madness state.
5. Now, the unlooted cars in zones have been added to the misc. category of the resource exploration statistics.
6. The description of the exploration statistics for zones has been revised to be clearer.
7. Optimized the interaction of page scrolling in various storage boxes.
8. Optimized the speed of entering the action of sofa-reading at home.
9. Now, when you press "Sort" in various storage boxes, the backpack will be sorted simultaneously.
10. Now, when small animals return to their nests, they can no longer be attacked.

[h3]Developer Update[/h3]

Due to the lockdowns in Beijing during November and the surging "positive wave" in December, the work of the development team has been impacted by a few weeks (tears!), but fortunately, as of December 23, 70% of the team has returned to work! We are working hard to minimize the impact on the progress of the work. So, please mothers, look forward to the arrival of the full version in the near future!

Happy Holidays, be safe and enjoy!

notes.title: A Closer Look at Update 0.5!
notes.content:
Take a closer look at what's new in Update 0.5 with our new trailer highlighting the key changes!

[previewyoutube=t-sn2u333oo;full][/previewyoutube]

Missed the notes? Check them out below! 

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Starting a new game? Cody will no longer be a pure rookie. When you start a new adventure, based on game difficulty, Cody will now start with a number of initial skills to help get you started! (In survival mode, you can also customize the number of Cody's initial skills when starting a new game).
[*]Cody can now collect continuously! After learning the appropriate skill, he can help Anling collect water, wood, and other resources continuously without having to pick them up one by one.
[*]The world map UI now adds a "regrown resource" hint. A simple reminder that certain vegetation and crops can now be harvested after being harvested previously!
[*]We have provided a set of free exclusive skins for Early Access players! There are three new sets of skins for both Anling and Cody!
[*]It’s Halloween! And it wouldn’t be Halloween without treats! You can now find special cupcakes within the world… but should they be eaten?
[*]The number of abandoned cars that can be looted has greatly increased.
[*]New boxes requiring lockpicks have been added in throughout the world.
[/list]

[b]Some data balance optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Firearm damage has been increased significantly.
[*] Mine and Ground Spike damage has been increased by 100%.
[*] Reduced the number of armed enemies and respawn rates at the Factory.
[*] Increased the chances of getting gasoline.
[*] You can loot wood in more locations.
[/list]

[b]Some experience optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Skin preview screen now supports character rotation.
[*] Based on player feedback, we have set an upper limit on the Mania symptom.
[*] The scroll wheel is now supported in more UI elements.
[*] Minimap control now supports controllers.
[*] When Cody learns an “Assist” skill, the “Teach Cody” UI will be replaced with “Assist.”
[*] When collecting wood and dismantling cars, new items will go to Inventory until the bag is full.
[/list]

In addition to the above updates, we are working very hard to bring you the next major update as we head closer and closer to the full launch! Please look forward to it!

notes.title: An Update on Undying's Development Progress!
notes.content:
To the Undying fans!

We know it’s been a while since you have heard from us, and when an indie studio goes silent, it can be a little scary. Will there be any more updates? Are the developers okay? Has the game been abandoned? These are reasonable questions to have. Well, we are here to assure you that we are fine and development is still going smoothly.

The reason we have been so quiet is that we are now going through the final major phase of development. Finalising and polishing the main storyline in order to give the most satisfying journey and ending; as well as porting work (You may remember Undying was featured in the latest NINTENDO INDIE WORLD SHOWCASE) to make sure that the game runs as smooth as possible no matter where you play it.

That doesn’t mean we don’t plan to update the game before launch. We have 2 major updates planned for Q4 this year. One around late October/early November and one at the end of December. We have some really cool stuff planned for these updates, especially if you are part of Early Access.

So again, we are fine, and things are going smoothly. We thank you so much for your patience, and we can’t wait for you to get your hands on what we have been working on. We just need a little more time to show you.

- The Vanimals Team

notes.title: June 10 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hi UNDYING fans, today we have something new for you guys!
 
1. Custom Difficulties now is ready for the Survival Mode! There are 12 options with this update, and there could be more in the future.
  - In “World Settings” there are [Day Length] and [Resource Regrowth]. Yes, Day Length is something we have controlled firmly for quite a long time. Now in the Survival Mode, you have the control!
  - In “Character Stats” there are [Hunger], [Thirst] and [Symptom Duration]. These will greatly affect how your body pace with time! “Mom, I’m huuuuuungray again!”
  - In “Inventory” there are [Item Stack], [Durability], and [Food Spoilage]. Our lovely hoarders, now it’s time to pile up your inventory!
  - In “Combat” there are [Damage], [Difficulty Increase], [Enemy Respawn] and [Enemy Stagger]. If you felt that zombies are a pain in your ass, now you are theirs. 
2. Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: March 2022 Major Update!
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors! 

We know it's been just a bit since we've had our last huge update but we promise it's well worth the wait! 

This update changes not only how you can control Cody, but also redesigns his entire skill system, adds more convenience for everyone, and then some! 

Let's get to it! 

[h3]Cody command Panel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/a939c1c7f5d7a2fe77524dc7c0a76bb4bd7a6fa1.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]You can now use the Cody command button (default button: middle mouse button or joystick on the right side of the controller(R3)) to bring up the wheel. 

There are 4 commands you can use from this wheel to help give control over Cody’s actions;
[olist]
[*]1: Stay and assist in the fight
2: Follow and assist in the fight
3: Stay 
4: Follow,
[/olist]
This will greatly improve the predictability of Cody's behavior in all situations.

[*]It should be noted that if any of Cody’s “Stay” commands are selected, some of Cody's automatically triggered AI logic will be interrupted. For example, if Cody has been given the “Stay” command and is interrupted by another input such as “Holding Hands”, he will return to the “Stay” command in his current position once the interruption is completed. 

[*]In the event that Cody has the skill to attack and is equipped with a slingshot AND, if Cody is selected to assist in Combat, Cody will continue to attack Anling's target. He will also fight back against enemies who take the initiative to attack first. In this state, if you want to stop Cody from attacking, you need to adjust the Cody command to Stay or Follow only. 

[*]When Cody is given a command, from the “Stay” state, to perform an interaction such as [opening the item spot], his “Stay” state will be switched to the “Follow” state. 

[*]Cody cannot accept commands if he is frightened by a zombie and will need to be calmed down before being given a command. 

[*]The default state of Cody is Follow and assist in the fight.

[h3]Cody’s Skill System is totally Redesigned[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/8c4f0fc6ab6b16fbb76b73b1462d3889ac62e8c3.png[/img]
[*]Talent Tree Unlock missions have been removed. 

[*]The previous skill trees have been removed.

[*]There are now 62 “Basic Skills” for Cody. The basic skills can be learnt by having Cody watch Anling performing actions s or practicing them by himself. The learning process is now more intuitive and realistic. There will be more skills available at launch, so stay tuned! 

[*]Added 36 upgradeable “Advanced Skills” including 15 in Craft, 16 in Survival, and 5 in Combat. The Advanced skills each type can be drawn from the skill pool by spending 100 experience points and can be “bought” directly after selecting the skills you want to learn. 

[*]Each advanced skill has a different level of upgradeability and has strong long-term potential – faster interaction, less resource consumptions, larger backpack capacity, more durable weapons, more effective food and medicine, and even some very different gameplay experiences. We believe that these advanced skills can improve the user experience with convenience. 

[*]Both the Basic and Advanced skill pools will be further expanded in future releases to provide more interesting gameplay experiences. 

[*]Due to the reconstruction of the skill system, the old skills you have learned in the previous save data cannot be transferred directly to the new build, and we will return all the experience points you have spent on skills. 

[h3]Combat system update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/2325488a7f4785abf350eff671152851f47c0d03.gif[/img]

[*]Brand new Combo System for One-Handed Weapons!: When using a one-handed weapon, if you quickly tap the attack button, and hit the target, it will trigger a combo with up to three melee attacks. The attacks will deal 100%, 100% and 140% damage, respectively, to the target. 

[*]Attack Cancellation: You can now use the move command to cancel the attack recovery animation, after an attack, to gain more fault tolerance in combat.

[*]Hit recovery: We have revamped the Hit Recovery of most weapons to be more reflective of their strength in regards to ordinary, combo, and critical attacks. In short, the higher the strength of the weapon itself, the greater chance it has to knockback, stun, and interrupt the target, depending on the enemy. This is not strictly related to the damage that weapons have and requires players to explore and learn in the combats.

[*]We have fine-tuned the damage of some weapons to give a better balance to combat.

[h3]Data balancing[/h3]

[*]The following additional effects of Anling’s symptoms and conditions have changed to the following Only the corresponding type of symptoms that are not cured, will be applied. 
[Violent Intention]
[Grit]
[Pain Externalization]
[Venom Accumulation]


[*]The following additional effects of Anling’s symptoms have been changed to: Only one corresponding effect can be obtained at the same time.
[Tenacity]
[Perseverance]
[Aggressive]
[Enhancement]
[Agility]


[*]Anling's symptom [Symptom Activation] has been changed to: Cannot be prolonged by the drug [Metalazal]. 

[h3]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h3]

[*]Fixed a rain effect bug when entering a new location.

[*]Like Anling, Cody now has 12 backpack slots by default.

[*]Some rabbits in the City and National Park areas will end their winter break be visible directly in the map.

[*]Fixed an issue that could lead to Cody earning extra experience points when multiple enemies were killed by one round of a shotgun.

[*][Planks] and [First Aid Kits] are now stackable.

[*]Fixed some achievement statistic errors.

[*]Fixed a bug that rain did not trigger as expected in certain cases.

[*]Fixed a problem where rabbits flashed in the rabbit hole when it rained.

[*]Changed the button binding of “Switch Locked Target” to (B) on XBOX controller, and (X) on PS controller.

[*]Cody won't push Anling away when he helps her while at the repair bench in their home.

[*]Fixed an issue where Diana could still be attacked by nearby zombies when she entered the conversation outside of the supermarket.

[*]A hidden recipe has been added to the food bench at home.

[/list]

That's all for this update but we've got so much in store for Undying with some extra exciting news heading your way soon. So stay tuned!

notes.title: UNDYING’s first major update! Zombie Hordes and Endless Mode have arrived!
notes.content:
A month of hard work after launching in Early Access, UNDYING now has it’s first major update!

[h3]SURVIVAL MODE aka Endless Mode is here! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/a271ebd99073b62a7a2a72446c61ad94f9add8bd.png[/img]

- Unlock Survival Mode after completing the story mode (30 days)
- Main features of Survival Mode:
     - Map locations are unlocked in random order. New experience every playthrough.
     - Challenges such as power outages, rain, zombie hordes, Anling’s symptoms and declines, etc., come earlier than in Story Mode.
     - Every few days, the enemy's HP and attack power will increase slightly.
     - Survival mode exclusive NPC the night merchant. Appears every few days, take advantage if you find him!
     - You only have one life in Survival Mode, if you die Game Over and you have to start over.
     - There are plenty more changes in Survival Mode to discover, so try it out and experience it for yourself!

Please note: Survival Mode is currently in an Alpha stage of development so we are still working out kinks! We would love to hear your feedback on this mode.

[h3]Mom! A zombie horde!! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/9274f53c11895b1a3fee05ef5d7dbf4dca5a2fc3.png[/img]

     -The zombie hordes will appear around Day 20 in the Story Mode and Day 7 of Survival Mode.
     -Try to use terrain and the new megaphone system to distract and avoid zombies!

[h3]AMD FSR frame rate optimization tech[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/866a11adb4b1878111d7f4875fe43d9e55067236.png[/img]

     -Low-end PCs and laptops can use AMD FSR to increase frame rates by 10%-30%. It’s effective with integrated, NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards.

[h3]Story content has been expanded in the Farm, the RV Camp, and the Underground Lab. Expect more content to be added in the next few weeks in December.[/h3]

[h3]Other bug fixes and experience optimization![/h3]

We are now about to enter development for our second major update (end of December). We would like to thank you for your support and we hope you continue enjoying Undying!

notes.title: Undying Alpha Demo Update!
notes.content:
Greetings from Vanimals!

So as many already know, we’ve pushed back the release window to the fall (hopefully no further changes!) and have been hard at work on getting the game to where it needs to be.

With that in mind, we’ve had our current demo version out in the wild for players to experience since the spring Steam Festival...so it’s long overdue for an update!

Wait…. AN UPDATE?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/ffd54860a02f79a1f37209d7de1132cb97dfb3fd.jpg[/img]

You bet and no it’s not just more Zombies for us all to hide Cody from!

One of our biggest sources of feedback has been from you all checking out the demo, reaching out to us be it here or on Discord (seriously join us there) to let us know your thoughts, concerns, and ideas for the game.

We greatly appreciate that and ask that you keep doing so!

So here is just a quick rundown of what to expect and of course, please let us know what you think!

[b]We took the 'work' out of 'Guesswork' with our brand new UI and UX[/b]
[list]
[*] The new UI conveys more information to the player while looking sleek and stylish
[*] Tutorials, quests, tips and hints make the experience directed while giving the player the freedom to do whatever!
[*] Introducing the Minimap V0.1!
[*] Oh, the world map has been touched up as well
[*] Managing your storage is not a chore anymore. Unlike real-life
[*] Track what ingredients you need wherever you go
[*] Dropped loot is now easier to see. Now if only zombies dropped crowbars
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/fcbc8c48a87c4ddbc32079f5e1fc26283c634062.png[/img]

[b]Balance, balance, and balance.[/b] 
[list]
[*] No need to use twenty crowbars to defeat one zombie!
[*] Surviving is now a challenge and not an impossibility
[*] Made securing resource supply chain manageable
[/list]
[b]Sam Fisher joins the fray![/b]
[list]
[*] No, not really. But that'd be cool right? However, Anling can now sneak around to avoid combat
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/5f13f23c7c8ac3f6078402aadbe56d5a26290c90.png[/img]

[b]Home Alone meets Undying[/b]
[list]
[*] Channel the power of Kevin McCallister to craft new defensive fixtures
[/list]
[b]Pew, Pew, Pew[/b]
[list]
[*] It's easier to get Cody a slingshot now making him effective in fights from earlier in the game
[/list]
[b]Intro storyboard? Not anymore![/b] 
[list]
[*] We've turned that black and white storyboard into a cinematic, with colour!
[*] It's still a WIP
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/d4bc31b53f8c0138fe3aead7f009b53f032f0c0c.png[/img]

Thanks again and stay tuned for the next update about the game coming very very soon! 

Make sure to wishlist Undying!

~Team Vanimals

notes.title: Recapping 2019
notes.content:
2019 was a huge year for us at Vanimals. This was the year that we revealed or next project to the world of Undying. We would like to take this opportunity to recap some the highlights of this year as well as what to expect in 2020. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/e1e2758aa6e1d097e0e138983cb8f79d2f04b860.jpg[/img]

[h1]E3 and the Undying Reveal[/h1]

If you had told us last year that we would be unveiling our new game at E3 this year we wouldn’t have believed you, but that’s exactly what happened! Not only that, the reveal was dropped during the E3 Kinda Funny Games Showcase. It was so great to be featured beside so many wonderful Indies and we have to thank Greg Miller and the Kinda Funny team for letting us be a part of the show.

The E3 show floor was also such a wonderful and surreal experience for us, not only because we were featured right next to the Monster Hunter World: Iceborne booth but also because this was the first-time people would get hands on our game. The reception was amazing, and we also got great feedback. It was great to hear firsthand what clicked with people and what might need more work.

E3 was a blast and we hope to make it back there again one day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217060/b9a564e411ab12418cabfb33b3657701780818e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gamescom[/h1]

After barely recovering from E3 we were off to Cologne for Gamescom. Easily the biggest games convention we have ever experienced. So many more people got a chance to get hands on the game and again it was wonderful to get so much feedback and hearing how many people were excited about Undying.
 
Gamescom also gave us the chance for us to meet really interesting people within the industry, some who might have an impact on Undying in the future.

[previewyoutube=6mz94at9d0A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]PS4 and Nintendo Switch[/h1]

When we unveiled Undying at E3 we were able to say that it was being developed for PC and console. At all the shows we attended the most common questions that were being asked were “What consoles is this coming to?” and “Is it coming to…?”. It took us a little while, but in 2019 we are happy to confirm that Undying will be coming to PS4 and Nintendo Switch! We hope to add more platforms to the list in the future!

[h1]What’s next?[/h1]

We managed to achieve a lot in 2019 (in front and behind the scenes) but what can we expect from Undying in 2020? The big one for us is getting the game in to your hands. Though that will lean towards the later part of the year, we are planning for opportunities for you to get some hands on before that through a closed beta and other opportunities. We’ll keep you updated.

We do plan to bring Undying to more shows next year as well and we’ll begin sharing news on that soon as we are able to confirm which events we will be going to.

2019 was a jam packed year for us but undoubtedly 2020 will be even bigger as we work hard to bring Undying to your PCs and Consoles. So we hope are looking forward to it!

[h1]Thank You[/h1]

We at Vanimals want to say a big thank you to you. We had an incredible year and it’s all thanks to your excitement. We really want to bring you the best game we can and knowing that there are people eager to play it really motivates us and we hope not to let you down.

So from all of us at Vanimals…

Happy Holidays! We’ll see you in 2020!
